title: knewsr
text: English knewsr는 한국어 뉴스 데이터의 수집과 전처리를 자동화하고, 빈도·TF-IDF·DTM·공기어·키니스·기간별 추이 같은 기초 텍스트 분석을 몇 줄의 R 코드로 끝내는 패키지입니다. Excel·CSV·JSON 파일(BigKinds 내보내기 포함), 제목·본문 컬럼이 있는 어떤 data.frame, 네이버 뉴스 검색 API, RSS/Atom 피드를 모두 같은 파이프라인에 넣을 수 있습니다.

title: knewsr
text: 아직 CRAN에 배포되지 않았습니다. tokenize_ko()는 기본적으로 keyword 컬럼(BigKinds 내보내기의 키워드 등)을 나누므로 형태소 분석기가 필요 없습니다. 네이버나 RSS로 수집한 데이터처럼 키워드 컬럼이 없으면 제목이나 본문을 분석해야 하며(field = "title" 또는 "text"), 이때는 시스템 MeCab-ko, mecab-ko-dic과 RcppMeCab 패키지가 필요합니다. JSON 파일은 jsonlite, 네이버 수집은 httr2, RSS 수집은 xml2가 필요합니다. 네이버 API 키는 NAVER_CLIENT_ID, NAVER_CLIENT_SECRET 환경변수로 설정합니다.
code: devtools::install_github("sorrychoe/knewsr")

title: knewsr
text: 자세한 흐름은 vignette("getting-started", package = "knewsr")를 참고하세요.

title: Getting started with knewsr
text: 모든 입력은 표준 스키마(doc_id, date, source, title, text, keyword)로 바뀝니다. 파일은 read_news()로 읽습니다. Excel, CSV/TSV(UTF-8, CP949), JSON, JSONL을 받고, 폴더를 주면 안의 파일을 모두 읽어 합칩니다. BigKinds 내보내기도 같은 함수로 읽습니다. 이미 메모리에 있는 data.frame은 as_news()로 바꿉니다. 흔한 컬럼명(headline, body, content, pubDate, press 등)은 자동으로 찾고, 찾은 결과를 메시지로 알려 줍니다. 자동 인식이 틀리면 text = "본문열"처럼 직접 지정합니다.

text: 기본값은 BigKinds keyword 컬럼을 쓰는 것이라 형태소 분석기가 필요 없습니다. keep으로 지정한 컬럼은 토큰 테이블에 함께 붙습니다. 본문을 직접 분석하려면 시스템에 MeCab-ko와 mecab-ko-dic을 설치하고 RcppMeCab 패키지를 설치합니다.

title: Preprocessing and Basic Text Mining for Korean News
text: Korean knewsr collects preprocesses Korean news data runs basic text analysis lines R: term frequencies, TF-IDF, document-term matrices, co-occurrence, keyness term trends time. Excel, CSV JSON files (including BigKinds exports), data frame title body columns, Naver News Search API RSS/Atom feeds feed pipeline.

title: Preprocessing and Basic Text Mining for Korean News
text: knewsr CRAN yet. Install development version GitHub: default, tokenize_ko() splits keyword column (keyword lists BigKinds exports) needs morphological analyser. Data without keyword column, Naver RSS collections, must tokenized title body (field = "title" "text"), needs MeCab-ko system library, mecab-ko-dic RcppMeCab package. Reading JSON files needs jsonlite, collecting Naver needs httr2 collecting RSS needs xml2. Set Naver API keys NAVER_CLIENT_ID NAVER_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.
code: devtools::install_github("sorrychoe/knewsr")

what: Convert a data frame to the standard news schema — as_news
title: Convert a data frame to the standard news schema — as_news
text: Maps columns news data frame standard schema used every function: doc_id (chr), date (Date), source (chr), title (chr), text (chr) keyword (chr, comma-separated). Columns mapped kept standard ones.

title: Convert a data frame to the standard news schema — as_news
code: as_news(   df,   text = NULL,   title = NULL,   date = NULL,   source = NULL,   keyword = NULL,   id = NULL,   keyword_sep = ",",   dedup = FALSE,   quiet = FALSE )

title: Convert a data frame to the standard news schema — as_news
text: df data frame news articles, one row per article. text, title, date, source, keyword, id Column names df, NULL detect, NA leave empty. Without id column, row numbers used. keyword_sep Separator used keyword column; converted commas. list column keywords also accepted. dedup TRUE, drop repeated articles: rows id, title, date source (text, titles). quiet TRUE, report detected columns. warning still raised title, date source detected; pass NA field leave empty purpose.

title: Convert a data frame to the standard news schema — as_news
text: tibble standard news schema.

title: Convert a data frame to the standard news schema — as_news
text: Columns left NULL detected name, case-insensitively, list common names: BigKinds' Korean headers, title/headline, text/body/content/description, date/pubDate/published, source/press/media, id/guid others. chosen mapping reported message. column name must exist; NA skips field. least one text keyword required. Dates parsed element element YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYYMMDD, Korean YYYY년 M월 D일 RFC 822 (Mon, 02 Jan 2024 13:05:00 +0900, RSS) forms, without time; calendar date written kept. Values parsed become NA warning.

title: Term co-occurrence — cooccurrence
text: Counts often pairs terms appear together, either document within sliding window tokens.

title: Term co-occurrence — cooccurrence
code: cooccurrence(   tokens,   window = "doc",   top_n = 50,   output = c("tibble", "matrix") )

title: Term co-occurrence — cooccurrence
text: tokens token table tokenize_ko() (doc_id, token). window "doc" counts documents terms occur. number w counts times two terms occur within w tokens document (order tokens). top_n consider top_n frequent terms (document frequency). NULL keeps terms. output "tibble" pair list "matrix" symmetric sparse term--term matrix.

title: Keyness between groups — keyness
text: Compares often term occurs target group versus rest corpus (chosen reference group), using 2 x 2 contingency table per term.

title: Keyness between groups — keyness
code: keyness(tokens, group, target, reference = NULL, measure = c("lr", "chi2"))

title: Keyness between groups — keyness
text: tokens token table tokenize_ko() (doc_id, token). group Grouping column tokens, e.g. "source" (carry tokenize_ko(keep = )). target Value group compare. reference Value(s) group compare . NULL uses every group. measure "lr" log-likelihood ratio (G2), "chi2" Pearson's chi-square (continuity correction).

title: Keyness between groups — keyness
text: tibble token, n_target, n_reference, keyness p, sorted keyness.

title: Keyness between groups — keyness
text: statistic signed: positive term relatively frequent target, negative frequent reference. p comes chi-square distribution one degree freedom.

title: knewsr 0.1.0
text: First release.

title: knewsr 0.1.0
text: read_news() reads Excel, CSV/TSV (UTF-8 CP949), JSON JSONL news files, whole directory ; read_bigkinds() alias BigKinds exports. as_news() converts news data frame one standard schema (doc_id, date, source, title, text, keyword). detects common column names (BigKinds headers, headline, body, content, pubDate, press, …), parses many date formats element element warns values parse, normalizes keyword separators list columns, can drop repeated articles (dedup = TRUE). warns title, date source column found, naming file called read_news(); pass NA field leave empty without warning. collect_naver() collects articles Naver News Search API. collect_rss() collects articles RSS 2.0 Atom feeds.

title: knewsr 0.1.0
text: clean_news() removes bracketed headers, bylines datelines, e-mail addresses, URLs special characters. stopwords_ko() returns default Korean news stopword list. tokenize_ko() builds token table keyword lists , RcppMeCab MeCab-ko, text; ngrams_ko() builds n-grams.

title: knewsr 0.1.0
text: count_terms(), tf_idf() summarise_corpus(). as_dtm() as_tdm() return sparse Matrix objects. cooccurrence() counts co-occurrence within documents token windows. keyness() compares groups log-likelihood ratio (G2, default) chi-square. term_trend() counts terms per day, week month.
